identityTest.stableIdentity: An attribution claim remains independently citable across method changes, reporting views, outcome corrections and competing claims.
identityTest.versionIdentity: Method, window, evidence, subject level, credit or supersession changes append a new claim rather than mutating the prior claim.
identityTest.mastership: authorized commercial analytics or attribution authority

owns: attribution window, credit fraction and confidence

references.purpose: Campaign revision, audience, channel and experiment evidence

excludes: proposal, order, contract or revenue identity

invariants: Attribution names method, version and exact window.
Pursuit, proposal, order and revenue claims remain distinct.
Claims under different methods coexist and are never averaged or summed together.
Credit fractions are bounded only within one subject, method version and window.
Attribution is model-relative credit and never causality by itself.
Causal claims cite separate experiment evidence.
Every claim pins upstream revisions or as-of time.
Claims never mutate campaign, pursuit, proposal, order, contract or revenue masters.
Recognized amounts come only from external authoritative masters.
Corrections append successor claims and preserve originals.
Independent enterprise dimensions scope claim identity and prevent collision.
Confidence, calibration and limitations remain explicit.
holds: Registry authority and identifier allocation are pending.
Order, contract, revenue, consent and legal-effect bindings remain external and incomplete.
Calibration, bias review, frozen audit and crosswalks remain pending.
